repos.hook: This repository provides Anthropic templates for financial services. It helps developers build AI agents for financial data analysis. Financial data means numbers and records about money.
repos.personalization: You can adapt these agent templates to build automated screening tools for Islamic finance compliance.

repos.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
repos.hook: Paperclip is an open-source tool for managing AI agents at work. It helps teams run, monitor, and coordinate multiple agents together.
repos.personalization: This provides a fullstack control dashboard to orchestrate and test multi-agent setups across your projects.

repos.hook: Hindsight is a memory system for AI agents. It stores past interactions so agents can learn and improve over time.
repos.personalization: Useful for evaluating how persistent memory layers affect prompt performance and response accuracy.

repos.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
repos.hook: This project adds security audit skills to coding agents. It checks source code for security flaws and produces clear reports.
repos.personalization: A practical skill you can plug into your coding agents to verify code safety before pushing changes.

repos.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
repos.hook: WeKnora converts raw documents into a searchable knowledge base. It uses retrieval-augmented generation to answer questions from your data. Retrieval-augmented generation means finding relevant text before generating an answer.
repos.personalization: A strong architecture to study when building RAG systems for Islamic reference texts or ethical guidelines.

repos.description: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code
repos.hook: This tool helps you configure and monitor Claude Code from your terminal. It lets you manage configuration templates and track token usage.
repos.personalization: Directly relevant for your daily workflow when benchmarking and standardizing Claude Code setups.

repos.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
repos.hook: Orca is a development environment for running multiple coding agents in parallel. You can use your own model subscriptions across desktop, mobile, and remote servers.
repos.personalization: Great to evaluate when testing how parallel coding agents handle fullstack TypeScript and Python tasks.

repos.hook: Next.js is a popular web framework for building React applications. It handles frontend user interfaces and backend server routes in one project.
repos.personalization: A core fullstack framework to keep updated on for your web applications and side projects.

repos.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
repos.hook: CLI-Anything converts command-line software into tools that AI agents can use. It creates structured commands so agents can execute software tasks reliably.
repos.personalization: Helpful when you need to expose custom command-line evaluation scripts directly to agentic coding tools.

repos.description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration
repos.hook: PyTorch is an open-source framework for machine learning. It performs fast mathematical calculations on graphics processing units to train models.

repos.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
repos.hook: Claude Code is an agentic coding assistant that runs in your terminal. It reads codebases, writes code, and executes git workflows through natural language.
repos.personalization: A prime target for your AI coding tool evaluations and your day-to-day engineering workflow.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.hook: ECC is an optimization harness for coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor. It provides skills, memory systems, and security rules to improve agent speed and accuracy.
repos.personalization: Directly matches your applied ML work on agent harness tuning and prompt optimization.

repos.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.hook: This repository teaches practical AI engineering concepts step by step. It provides clear code examples to build AI applications without heavy frameworks.
repos.personalization: Fits your applied focus on mastering core AI engineering patterns without relying on academic theory.

repos.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
repos.hook: Open Code Review uses static rules and AI agents to review pull requests. It detects bugs like SQL injection and writes line-level comments on your code.
repos.personalization: A solid tool to evaluate for automated quality and security checks on your fullstack repositories.

repos.description: 🥧 Savoury implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3
repos.hook: Quiche is a Rust library that implements the QUIC network protocol and HTTP/3. It helps developers create fast and secure network applications.

repos.description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
repos.hook: Octop is a self-hosted AI assistant platform that supports multiple users and agents. You can host it on your own server to keep your data private.
repos.personalization: An interesting self-hosted option if you need private multi-agent infrastructure for your personal projects.

repos.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
repos.hook: This repository provides open-source plugins for Anthropic Claude. These plugins help knowledge workers automate office tasks and document workflows.
repos.personalization: A useful reference for real-world prompt design and tool definitions from the Anthropic team.

repos.description: Fix X/Twitter and Bluesky embeds! Use multiple images, videos, polls, translations and more on Discord, Telegram and others
repos.hook: FxEmbed fixes social media link previews in chat applications. It extracts images, videos, and translations so posts display correctly in chat apps.
